steps.en: Staff logs in and reaches ACM only if they hold an ACM role.
steps.id: Staff login dan masuk ACM hanya kalau punya role ACM.
steps.why_en: The sign-in itself is handled outside the code we can see.
steps.why_id: Proses login sendiri ada di luar code yang bisa dicek.

steps.en: Only the menu hides this page from non-admins.
steps.id: Hanya menu yang menyembunyikan halaman ini dari non-admin.
steps.why_en: The page address and the system do not check the admin role.
steps.why_id: Alamat halaman dan sistem tidak cek role admin.

steps.en: Staff sees a table of all functions with app, module, name and ID.
steps.id: Staff melihat tabel semua function dengan app, module, nama, dan ID.

steps.en: Staff can search and export to CSV, but cannot sort.
steps.id: Staff bisa search dan export ke CSV, tapi tidak bisa sort.

steps.en: Add New Function opens a form with all the required fields.
steps.id: Add New Function membuka form dengan semua field yang diminta.

steps.en: Submitting saves the new function in the system.
steps.id: Submit menyimpan function baru ke sistem.

steps.en: Edit lets staff change the URL as well, not only the description.
steps.id: Edit membolehkan staff ubah URL juga, bukan hanya deskripsi.
steps.why_en: The spec says description only, but the URL can also be changed.
steps.why_id: Spec bilang hanya deskripsi, tapi URL juga bisa diubah.

steps.en: Delete asks for confirmation in a pop-up, then removes the function.
steps.id: Delete minta konfirmasi lewat pop-up, lalu function dihapus.

steps.en: Changes take effect right away with no approval.
Failures show a pop-up, but only a generic message.
steps.id: Kegagalan menampilkan pop-up, tapi hanya pesan umum.
steps.why_en: The pop-up does not say what exactly went wrong.
steps.why_id: Pop-up tidak menyebut apa yang salah.
